messages:
incident-bot: Paging: runtime-oncall - Elevated p95 latency on canary after deploy (svc: text-gen-runtime, region: us-west1). Trigger: p95 > 250ms for 5m. Link: https://dashboards/internal/abcd

deploy-bot: Deploy 3827 started traffic shift to canary at 2026-03-17T15:21:40Z. Rollout flags: ff-quant-3827 -> ENABLED on canary.

alex: oncall here, looking into it.

priya: I see a sharp p95 bump, batching window shrank in the canary pool and kernel fallback count spiked.

alex: Logs show kernel-selection fallback to scalar-emulation on 4/12 canary hosts around deploy time.

marco: I toggled the quant-kernel flag for the rollout during the wave (ff-quant-3827) to test smaller quant kernels. Might be related.

sasha: Any customer-facing errors (5xx) or just latency?

alex: No 5xx spikes, but throughput is down ~30% on canary and several long tail timeouts reported by upstreams (~500ms app-level). Some requests retried.

ops-bot: Metric alert: KV cache hit-rate (canary) dropped 94% -> 60% concurrent with kernel fallback.

priya: Proposed steps: 1) pause traffic shift 2) flip ff-quant-3827 off for canary 3) set kernel-affinity to fast-path 4) monitor for 10m.

alex: Pausing traffic shift now.

marco: Starting kill-switch toggle for ff-quant-3827.

marco: `curl -fsS -X POST "https://flags.infra/api/v1/flags/ff-quant-3827/toggle" -d '{"state":"off"}'` -> 200 OK

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused. Canary traffic pinned to 0%.

alex: Forcing kernel affinity on canary hosts:
```
for h in canary-host-1 canary-host-2 canary-host-3 canary-host-4; do
  ssh $h "sysctl -w runtime.kernel_affinity=fast"
 done
```

alex: Monitoring: p95 trending back toward baseline, will update in 60s.

incident-bot: Handoff: runtime-oncall -> priya for live mitigation and follow-up.

priya: I'll own the mitigation and coordinate rollback if this doesn't stabilize. Setting severity -> sev2.

sasha: Notifying CS and PS to prepare for customer callbacks. Affected region: US-WEST, potential impact on APAC routing edge cases.

ops-bot: KV cache hit-rate recovering: 60% -> 88% after flag flip and kernel affinity change.

alex: Throughput still -10% vs baseline but tail latency p99 improving. Small-slice workloads still slower.

marco: Initiating quick data-plane revert of canary image on 4 hosts (rolling rollback), ETA ~8m.

alex: Rollback started.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigation in progress, acknowledged by oncall.

priya: Customer impact assessment: ~4 customer tenants saw 5-10% increased request errors/timeouts during the window. CS notified with templated blurb.

alex: Postmortem placeholder created: deploy 3827 - quant-kernel interaction with thin-slice workloads caused fallback and cache thrash. Follow-ups: stricter canary isolation, flag safety net, kernel selection probe tests.

sasha: Thanks team — keeping thread open until full stability verified.
